comments.content: `ValueOrDefault` requires `T` to be default-constructible because of `T{}`. This breaks for types like `blink::mojom::FetchCacheMode` or `printing::mojom::DuplexMode` if they are not default-constructible, and also for `std::u16string` it's fine but for enums it may not be. Consider using `std::optional<T>` or a different implementation that doesn't require default construction, e.g. `T value; if (Get(key, &value)) return value; return default_value;` — but that still requires default construction. Better: use `std::optional<T>` or require `T` to be default-constructible and document it. The current code will fail to compile for non-default-constructible types.
